component.name: open-mpv
component.summary: View local photos and videos without distractions

description.p: open-mpv is a fast, minimalist photo and video viewer for GNOME on Wayland. It opens local media without a library, database, network service, or persistent background process.
Browse a folder, zoom and rotate images, play local videos and subtitles, move files to trash with undo, and copy transient Quick Markup annotations without changing the source image.
